name: webdesk
description: Web-based remote desktop for Linux: SSH login, WebRTC screen, mouse and keyboard

scripts.build:host: cd host && GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -trimpath -o dist/webdesk-host-linux-amd64 . && GOOS=linux GOARCH=arm64 CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -trimpath -o dist/webdesk-host-linux-arm64 .
scripts.test:target: (test -f test/ssh/id_ed25519 || (mkdir -p test/ssh && ssh-keygen -q -t ed25519 -N '' -C webdesk-test -f test/ssh/id_ed25519)) && docker compose up -d --build target
